info.title: kickNX
info.author: j2k
info.description: Kick streaming client for Nintendo Switch
info.details: kickNX is an independent Kick client built specifically for the Nintendo Switch. It brings livestream viewing, category discovery, search, and integrated chat interaction to handheld, tabletop, and docked play.

changelog:
vLatest
kickNX v0.5.0

A controller-first, native Kick client for Nintendo Switch homebrew.



 What's New in v0.5.0

 Features & UI
- Colour Themes:- OLED (default), Dark Grey and Kick. Pick one from the new Theme- button on Home; the pop-up shows a preview of each and the choice is saved instantly.
- Kick Theme:- Muted Kick green pages with light grey cards and a dark "K" pattern behind the headers, streamer pages and sign-in screen. Docked chat follows the active theme.
- Live Events:- A Live events row on Home. Each event opens a page with its banner, live streams and most-viewed clips.
- In-App Chat Keyboard:- The landscape composer now opens an on-screen keyboard (Caps Lock, symbols, Emotes key) with see-through keys so the stream stays visible. The Nintendo keyboard is still available under Player Settings → Message composer.
- Controller Scrubbing:- Select the progress bar, hold A and move the left stick or D-pad to pick a spot, then release A to jump there. L/R nudge by 10 seconds while held; tapping A still plays/pauses.
- Check for Updates:- A button on the About page checks GitHub for a newer kickNX release.
- Stream Title on Live OSD:- The top of the player shows the channel and stream title.
- ZL Hint:- "Tap or press ZL" under Send message in docked and overlay chat.

 Changes
- Kick-Only Client:- Removed the leftover Jellyfin, media library, server setup, USB browser, music player, WebDAV and danmaku code. kickNX starts straight on the Kick home screen.
- Offline Streams:- When a channel goes offline, the player shows a message and returns to the previous screen.
- Live Playback:- Auto quality uses Kick's adaptive master playlist.
- Larger Profile Picture- on Home, and the unused R shortcut on Home was removed.

 Fixes
- SSL Connect Errors:- kickNX limits how many secure connections it opens at once, so thumbnails no longer break sign-in, playback or Home sections.
- Opening Chat Too Early:- ZL and Send message wait until the stream has started.
- Right-Stick Scrolling:- Works while a top-bar button is selected and wakes the controller after touch input.
- OSD Focus, Emote Backspace- and leaving an ended stream from a sub-screen.



 Installation

 Homebrew App Store:
- We are currently waiting to be added to the Homebrew App Store.

 Manual Installation:
1. Download kickNX-0.5.0.zip- (or kickNX.nro).
2. If using the zip, extract it directly to the root of your SD card so that the file is located at:
   text
   sdmc:/switch/kickNX/kickNX.nro
   
3. Launch kickNX from the Homebrew Menu.

> [!TIP]
> Full RAM Mode Recommended:- For the best performance and 60 FPS playback stability, launch the Homebrew Menu by holding the R- button while launching any installed game (title override), rather than launching through the Album.

v0.5.0
- Colour themes: OLED, Dark Grey and Kick, chosen from the Theme button on Home
- Live events row with event pages showing live streams and popular clips
- In-app on-screen chat keyboard in landscape, with an Emotes key
- Hold A on the progress bar and use the left stick or D-pad to scrub
- Check for updates button on the About page
- Kick-only client: Jellyfin, media library and other non-Kick features removed
- Offline streams return to the previous screen automatically
- Right-stick scrolling and touch-to-controller fixes
- Fixes for SSL connect errors, a crash after closing a stream quickly, and a damaged settings file
